newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips sells 25 pct Bang & Olufsen stake.
newsitem.headline: Philips sells 25 pct Bang & Olufsen stake.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Tuesday it had agreed to sell its 25 percent stake in Danish audio and television maker Bang & Olufsen A/S to Bang & Olufsen Holding for about 160 million guilders ($84 million).
In a statement, Philips said it had bought the stake in 1990 for about 100 million guilders.

"The close cooperation which exists between the two companies will be continued," it said. The cooperation agreement is to be extended for another five years, ensuring B&O's access to Philips' technology and Philips' status as B&O's preferred supplier.
Philips and B&O said that a substantial economic recovery in recent years had enabled B&O to buy back the stake and become the sole shareholder in its audio and video subsidiary.

"We have substantial excess cash and it is in the interest of both the group and its shareholders to use part of that liquidity for this purpose, as long as this does not affect our successful cooperation with Philips," B&O chairman Anders Knutsen was quoted as saying.
